system.description: Even if in full view of a target, your successful stealth task allows you to slip away from that creature and hide from view in a nearby shadow, behind a tree or furnishing, or in the next room as your action. Effort: Increase the number of creatures you can hide from by one (attempt a separate stealth task against each). Enabler. At tier 3: The base number of targets you can attempt to hide from increases to three. Slipping into shadow and other stealth-based tasks for someone who Walks Through Walls is partly enabled by their ability to phase into translucence.
